partition_method.basis: Original unmodified text-block JSON string encoded as UTF-8. Outer RESPONSE.json escaping and image base64 are counted separately.
partition_method.category_span_hashes: SHA-256 of the category's original UTF-8 spans concatenated in original text order.
partition_method.field_contributions: JSON Pointer rows report exclusive directly owned bytes. Parent rows exclude all descendant-owned bytes.
partition_method.ownership: Each field owns its quoted key, colon and following whitespace, its scalar/atomic-array value, and its container delimiters/whitespace. Descendant fields take their own bytes. Commas belong to the containing object/array. Root syntax belongs to other. Empty arrays retain their owning field category.
partition_method.priority: An explicit source-index or coordinate field overrides its inherited category. Binding fields then override inherited task facts. Explicit fact roots then set task_facts. All remaining fields inherit their parent category, starting at other.
partition_method.repeated_information: Each original occurrence contributes once at its actual serialized location. Repeated values across fields remain part of the delivered byte cost.

response_detail_schema.description: Optional display projection. surface_scan defaults to brief: a versioned table preserves all delivered matches, raw metre distances, derived millimetres, identities, scopes and unknowns. distance_mm uses a number, or an exact decimal string when binary64 millimetres overflow. Its object table covers matched endpoints. Full requests a new current observation with detailed witnesses; combine observations by scene/source binding. active_observation also defaults to brief, with all objects, region unknowns, actual pixel facts and native image references; full retains diagnostics. source_region defaults to brief with its complete selected-triangle measurement scope, witnesses and visibility. Other modes default to full; their brief omits named camera/raster diagnostics while preserving measurements and native images. Errors and unsupported projections retain the detailed response.
